status: Dated implementation supplement to frozen MathCan ROC-01 Part4 and Amendment C; committed BEFORE ROC-02 task samples
evidence_boundary: This supplement specifies encoding/sampler and optimizer details absent from frozen Part4, without changing seeds, sizes, rank grid or physical interventions. Prior NRF/ROC-02A data are retrospective and excluded from prospective selection.

task.name: delayed-rule binding with distractor rewrites
task.semantic_rule: Source A bind event presents an 8-element bijective lookup table. Distractors rewrite only B/C. Final query requests A[x]. Separate exact oracle and arithmetic check. The neural input receives the full lookup table but never the generator family ID.
task.input_encoding: 4 event-type bits, 3 source bits, 64 lookup table bits and 8 query bits per event, 79 total. A binds only at t=0.
task.source_composition: 0–4 distractor bindings to B/C within the delay. Strict source-family-disjoint train/cal/test via separate target-rule families.
task.invalid_samples: 24 separate validation-only error fixtures for no-rule and out-of-domain, excluded from the eight-label supervised train/dev/test splits
task.uniqueness: SHA256 canonical JSON of events, source, delay and query; reject duplicates within and across splits.
task.teacher: Independent dictionary-by-source symbolic interpreter plus direct arithmetic oracle for valid A queries

model.architecture: Tied residual 128D tanh two-linear update with token injection and shared readout; one transition per event plus 8 or 16 extra thought transitions, initial h=0
model.optimizer: AdamW lr=0.001 weight_decay=0; 240 optimizer steps, batch8, same per-seed sequence of training examples across depths
model.budget: 2×6 cells, 240 updates each; model and optimizer hashes frozen before observer fitting
model.native_symbolic_baseline: Direct lookup is required to solve 100% of valid tasks and reject error fixtures

observer.gates: ROC-01 Amendment C, independently verified labels, 100+ distinct null subspaces; no unverified causal tagging

execution: First commit config and oracle tests; then generate train/calibration/sealed test with published manifest. Lock neural checkpoints before fitting observers; never select rank/gamma on sealed test outcomes.
resources: Local CPU only; no paid training
